title: Northgate Store and Online Orders: Working Out the Replacement Haul-Away Credit
content:
**1. Settlement read.** For a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the settlement read is the customer's most recent Northgate Protect claim settlement on the records of Northgate Protect Protection Plans (administered by Keystone Protection Services); where two settlements share the most recent date, the one recorded first is read.

**2. Orders owed nothing.** A settlement by repair, a food loss payment, a settled item whose category no line of the order carries, and a settlement dated after the order date or more than ninety days before it owe no replacement haul-away credit; nor does an order whose haul-away charge is not above zero. Every count of calendar days leaves out the day it starts from and includes the day it ends on; the settlement's distance is counted from the settlement date to the order date.

**3. Amount.** The standard replacement haul-away credit is one quarter (25 percent) of the haul-away charge on the order, rounded half up to the cent. The replacement haul-away credit percentage is that standard quarter together with every extra percentage on the order. The credited haul-away, which is the haul-away charge on the order, is multiplied once by that percentage, the result is rounded half up to the cent, and the credit never exceeds the haul-away charge standing on the order, that is the haul-away charged less refunds already booked against it.

**Hypothetical cases.**

| Most recent settlement | Days before the order date | Order carries that category | Haul-away charge | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| replacement | 0 (same day) | yes | 40.00 | 10.00 |
| reimbursement | 90 | yes | 40.00 | 10.00 |
| replacement | 91 | yes | 40.00 | nothing owed |
| repair | 12 | yes | 40.00 | nothing owed |
| replacement | 12 | no | 40.00 | nothing owed |
